text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: Harmful content: ToxiGen, HateCheck, AEGIS2. Jailbreak: Detect-Jailbreak, Jailbreak-Classification, JailbreakHub.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: PII: Nano-1K, Mini-10K; presence detection only, not masking quality; AUROC is undefined.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: Each metric is the arithmetic mean of per-dataset metrics, not pooled samples or F1 recomputed from means.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: Missing required data or undefined metrics = N/A; category scopes are never reduced to available datasets.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', serif

g.text: Latency averages the same reference timings as the per-dataset chart; protocols differ and include failure waits.
